tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// ser ba zlog pa'i khro rgyal rdo rje mchu'i las byang rdo rje'i gur chen bzhugs//

'di ser ba srung ba'i tshe chag med bya/ sngon 'gro rgyun du mi dgos/ bsnyen pa rgyun khyer dang dgong mo tshogs dang gtor 'bul bya/ gshegs gsol bsdu rim skya mchod bar mi bya'o// ྈྈྈྈ gu ru dhe wa dhā ki ni: na mo dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum: skyabs gnas rnams la skyabs su mchi: 'gro kun sangs rgyas la 'god phyir: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: ka dag klong nas sprul pa yi: gnam sa gang ba'i mchod pa'i sprin: sman gtor rak+ta lha mor bcas: zad med gyur cig pū dza ho: rin chen snod du gtor ma ni: bdud rtsir gyur cig oṃ āḥhūm̐: gnyug gnas glo bur lhags pa yi: gnas bdag gzhi bdag 'byung po'i tshogs: 'dir 'dus mchod sbyin gtor ma bzhes: gnas 'dir gsang sngags sgrub pa la: ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad par: dkar phyogs sdongs grogs mthun rkyen sgrubs: nag phyogs bgegs rigs gzhan du dengs: gal te mi 'gro 'tshe byed na: ye shes khro bos brlag par 'gyur: de bas bsgo ba'i bka' la nyon: oṃ sarba lo ka pā la i dam ba lin ta khā hi khā hi: sarba bigh+nān gats+tsha gats+tsha: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: kha thaṃ ghu h+ya: ྈྈྈྈ ces pa sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje dgung lo bcu gsum bya lo chu stod zla ba'i tshes gsum la blo ldan mchog sred kyis dngos su gsungs so/// / ༁ྃ: ྈྈྈ gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: rtsa gsum spyi yi las byang gzhung srong ni: sta gon rim pa spyi dang mthun par byas: de nas 'don sgom sbrags la 'di ltar ro: hūm̐: nga ni khro bo rdo rje mchu: bgegs dang log 'dren nga la nyon: nga yi bka' las 'da' ma byed: nga yi bka' las 'da' byed na: bdag nyid nga rgyal thugs khros te: thal ba rdul du brlag par byed: de bas da lta phyir dengs shig: oṃ sum+bha sogs/ hūm̐: nga ni khro bo rdo rje mchu: thugs kar gser gyi gwa'u nang: bdag nyid dpon slob bsrung bya tshud:

steng 'og rdo rje'i gur khang gyur: oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐: hūm̐: ma 'grub bar du dkyil 'khor mi gtang na: rdo rje mchu yi lha tshogs ma lus rnams: srog la babs kyang bdag gis gzung bar bgyi: bdag gis dam tshig gtang bar mi bgyid do: hūm̐: rdo rje mchu yi lha tshogs ma lus rnams: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin chen dbab tu gsol: skal ldan dad ldan bdag la dbang mchog skur: log 'dren tshe yi bar chad bsal du gsol: oṃ badz+ra ā be sha ya ā: oṃ āḥm hā pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥtha: oṃ ma hā ba lin+ta hūm̐ hrīḥtha: oṃ āḥm hā rak+ta hūm̐ hrīḥtha: oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe sogs/ shab+da a hūm̐: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam khro bo rdo rje mchu: chos skyong nor lha kun gyi thugs dang ni: 'gal bar gyur pa ma lus ci mchis pa: bdag gis gnong zhing 'gyod pas mthol lo bshags: badz+ra sa ma ya shud+dhe a: chos rnams thams cad rang gi sems las byung: sems nyid ye nas stong pa nyid kyi ngang: sems can kun gyis de don ma rtogs pas: 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i sems can snying re rje: chos rnams thams cad rten 'brel rgyu las byung: hūm̐ ni rgyu yi sa bon nyid du gsal: de las raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gsum 'phros pa yi: raṃ gyi mes bsregs yaṃ gi rlung gis gtor: khaṃ gi chus bkrus stong pa nyid du brdal: e yaṃ khaṃ gsum bh+rūm̐ gyi yi ge yis: rang byung 'byung ba chen po lnga chags te: mkha' rlung chu dang ri rab gser gyi ri: de steng bh+rūm̐ gyi yi ge las bskyed pa'i: gzhal yas khang ni sgo gru rta babs rdzogs: gdugs tog chos 'khor ri dwags pad 'dab mtshan: rdor ra ye shes lnga yi me dpung 'bar: bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe e dzñā na tsakra maṇ+ḍal bh+rūm̐: de nas lha rnams so sor bskyed: 1$0000250༈ gu ru dhe ba dhā ki ni hūm̐:1$0000300 rdo rje mchu yi sgrub pa ni: dkyil 'khor med cing gtor ma med:

bdag mdun khro bo rdo rje mchu: sku mdog mthing nag zhal dgu pa: phyag ni bco brgyad phyag kun gyi: g.yas pa thams cad me dpung la: g.yon pas rlung gi 'tshub ma 'dzin: me rlung 'tshubs pa'i dbus na bzhugs: de yi spyi bor bya khyung ni: sku mdog nag po zhal dgu pa: phyag ni bco brgyad rtsa phyag gnyis: sbrul ni dkar nag gnyis gsol ba: de lhag g.yas brgyad me dpung la: g.yon pa brgyad ni rlung 'tshub bo: gnas gsum 'bru gsum hūm̐ khroṃ las: 'od 'phros ye shes spyan drangs bstim: hūm̐: sku gsum rtsa brgyud bla ma spyan 'dren no: khro bo rdo rje mchu dang khyung nag dang: yi dam lha tshogs ma lus spyan 'dren no: mkha' 'gro tshogs kun ma lus spyan 'dren no: chos skyong nor lha grogs mdzad spyan 'dren no: badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: hūm̐: sna tshogs pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: rtsa brgyud bla ma ma lus bzhugs su gsol: pad+ma nyi zla brjid pa'i gdan steng du: yi dam rdo rje mchu nyid bzhugs su gsol: bdud bzhi dregs pa bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: sprul pa khyung nag 'bar ba bzhugs su gsol: sna tshogs rin chen pad+ma'i gdan steng du: mkha' 'gro dpa' mo rgya mtsho bzhugs su gsol: pad+ma nyi zla bam ro'i gdan steng du: chos skyong srung ma thams cad bzhugs su gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro thams cad dang: rdo rje mchu dang khyung chen 'bar ba dang: chos skyong nor lha dam can rgya mtsho la: bdag gis rab tu gus dang dad pa yis: lus ngag yid gsum dwangs bas phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū ho: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam khro bo rdo rje mchu: khyung nag 'bar ba dam can thams cad la: mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos dang: mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo dang: gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri zhim ro mngar dang: reg bya 'jam pa dag gi mchod pa 'bul: ye shes lnga yi bdud rtsi chen po dang: bha ling gtor ma'i zhal zas brjid pa dang:

khams gsum bsgral pa rak+ta'i mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs kyi rig ma dkar dmar mthing: shin tu mdzes pa lta na sdug pa la: rin chen dar zab mang po'i rgyan gyis brgyan: bla ma yi dam rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang: rdo rje mchu dang khyung nag 'bar ba sogs: rtsa ba gsum la bdag gis mchod pa 'bul: log 'dren dgra bgegs bstan la gnod byed rnams: chos kyi dbyings su bdag gis bsgral byas te: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang: rdo rje mchu dang khyung chen zhal du 'bul: ar+ghaṃ sogs/ shab+da rū pa/ shab+da/ gan+dhe/ ra sa/ spar+she/ a mṛta ba liṃ rak+ta ma ṭaṃ ru tra pra we sha ya kha kha khā hi khā hi: hūm̐: dad ldan bu la byin rlabs char 'beb pa'i: bla ma'i lha tshogs kun la bstod par bgyi: dngos grub ma lus lhun gyis grub mdzad pa'i: khro bo rdo rje mchu dang khyung nag 'bar: yi dam kun la bdag gis bstod par bgyi: 'gro ba snang srid dbang du sdud mdzad pa'i: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bdag gis bstod par bgyi: bstan pa srung ba'i las la rab tu brtson: chos skyong kun la bdag gis bstod par bgyi: dgos 'dod re ba skong bar byed pa yi: nor lha'i tshogs la bdag gis bstod par bgyi: bstan la gnod byed sgrol bar mdzad pa yi: dam can tshogs la bdag gis bstod par bgyi: hūm̐: bla ma rnams la 'byor tshogs chung ba bshags: yi dam lha la spong len byas pa bshags: mkha' 'gro rnams la gsang ba bsgrags pa bshags: chos skyong rnams la mchod gtor chung ba bshags: tshangs pa chen po'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: de nas so sor dzap bsnyen bya: sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya: bdag mdun thugs kar nyi ma'i steng: hūm̐ mthar sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor: de las 'od zer 'phros pa yis: lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dang: dpag bsam shing gi rtse mo nas: rdo rje mchu dang khyung nag tshogs: kha ba bu yug 'tshub bzhin byon: bdag mdun sgrub rdzas rnams la thim:

byin rlabs me ltar 'bar bar gyur: oṃ badz+ra dun to i ka ni kon: tsa la ma la ti li swā hā: zhes pa'i bsnyen pa ci 'grub bya'o// de nas tshogs kyi rim pa ni// tshogs bran la 'di skad do: hūm̐: rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: raṃ las me 'phros dngos 'dzin bsregs: yaṃ las rlung byung bag chags gtor: khaṃ las chu byung gnyis 'dzin bkrus: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum 'od du zhu: bdud rtsi dkar dmar mthing dkar gyur: hūm̐: sku gsum rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rdo rje mchu dang khyung nag sogs: yi dam lha tshogs ma lus pa: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus kun: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: chos skyong srung ma ma lus kun: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: nor lha dam can rgya mtsho rnams: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: tshogs gtor 'di la byin gyis rlobs: rnal 'byor bsam pa sgrub tu gsol: rdo rje mchu dang khyung nag sogs: rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhes su gsol: bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsol: thugs dang 'gal bar gyur pa bshags: dam sri gnod byed zhal du bstab: gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī gha ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: ྈྈ ྈྈྈྈྈ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: rang nyid khro bo rdo rje mchu: thugs nas yi ge rnam gsum 'phros: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gsum me rlung chus: dngos 'dzin rtog pa'i dri ma sbyangs: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐: tshogs dang mchod rdzas dang re spro: tshogs 'di mchod pa'i gnas rnams ni: pad+ma 'byung gnas rje 'bangs rnams: dbu skra thor tshugs ldems se ldem: 'bul lo 'bul lo tshogs 'di 'bul: bzhes shig bzhes shig tshogs 'di bzhes: longs sku thugs rje chen po'i tshogs: rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan khra la la:

'bul lo 'bul lo tshogs 'di 'bul: bzhes shig bzhes shig tshogs 'di bzhes: gu ru zhi ba drag po'i tshogs: me yi phung po 'tshubs se 'tshub: 'bul lo 'bul lo tshogs 'di 'bul: bzhes shig bzhes shig tshogs 'di bzhes: tshe dpag lha tshogs yi dam lha: thams cad phyag cha rubs se rub: 'bul lo 'bul lo tshogs 'di 'bul: bzhes shig bzhes shig tshogs 'di bzhes: bka' brgyad dgongs 'dus phur pa'i tshogs: mche ba zangs yag gtsigs se gtsigs: 'bul lo 'bul lo tshogs 'di 'bul: bzhes shig bzhes shig tshogs 'di bzhes: khro bo chen po rdo rje mchu: spyi gtsug ye shes khyung bcas la: 'bul lo 'bul lo tshogs 'di 'bul: bzhes shig bzhes shig tshogs 'di bzhes: rnam sras la sogs nor lha rnams: rin chen rgyan cha si li li: 'bul lo 'bul lo tshogs 'di 'bul: bzhes shig bzhes shig tshogs 'di bzhes: dpal mgon ma ning dam can sogs: dbu skra gyen du zings se zing: 'bul lo 'bul lo tshogs 'di 'bul: bzhes shig bzhes shig tshogs 'di bzhes: bdag 'dzin ru tra sde gsum 'di: gsol cig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: gu ru dhe ba ḍā ki nī sarba dharma pā la gha ṇa tsakra pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes tshogs phud phul/ bar pas skong bshags ni/ hūm̐: rdo rje mchu dang khyung nag la: bkra shis rdzas rtags rin chen bdun: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yis: mchod pa 'bul lo thugs dam bskang: hūm̐: rdo rje mchu dang khyung nag la: 'khor ba'i ma rig 'khrul pa yis: ma shes thugs dang 'gal gyur to: mthol lo bshags so sa ma ya: de nas tshogs spel/ slob dpon la 'dren cing*/ hūm̐: rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: 'di la the tshom bya mi rung: khyi phag gdol pa bram ze gsum: de gsum gcig tu dgongs te rol: de nas slob dpon gyis/ a la la ho: zas la 'di 'dra mthong ma myong: yi dam lha yi gsol lhag yin: 'di 'dra'i zas ni ngo mtshar can:

bdag cag 'di la skyabs su zhu: zhes brjod do// de nas lhag ma la mkha' gsang phyag rgyas kha phru btab la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za dur bdag mo: lhag la dbang ba'i so sor gtor len rnams: lhag ma 'di bzhes gnod byed dgra bgegs rnams: thams cad rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: u tsiṣ+ṭa bha lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lhag la dbang bsgyur ma mo mkha' 'gro ni: sman mo bdud mo gnod sbyin dregs pa'i tshogs: lhag ma 'di bzhes dgra bgegs myur du sgrol: he ru ka'i mdun dam bcas ma g.yel bar: rtags dang mtshan ma thams cad myur du ston: ḍā ki nī du se na bha lin+ta kha raṃ khā hi: zhes lhag ma phul lo: de nas dmar gtor gnyis dang dkar gtor bsham/ chu gtsang bran la 'di nyid gyer bsgom bya/ ā+om̐ gyis gtor ma mi gtsang stong par sbyangs: ā las drag po'i thod snod rgya che bar: hūm̐ las gtor ma sha ri khrag mtshor gyur: hoḥyis zag med ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur: dmar la dga' ba thams cad tshim byed gyur: bh+rūm̐ las rin chen snod mchog rgya che bar: oṃ las gtor ma dkar gsum bdud rtsir gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis ro brgya nus pa stong: dkar la dga' ba thams cad tshim byed gyur: dmar gtor khyung dang rdo rje mchu la bsngo'o: hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi mthu stobs gcig bsdus pa: phyag na rdo rje shin tu khros pa'i sku: dbu dgu tho brtsegs zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs: dbu yi gtsug na khyung nag dbu dgu pa: me yi gshog pa rkyong bas nam mkha' khyab: kriṃ kriṃ sgra sgrog gza' klu'i snying du 'dar: khyung dang khro bo gnyis ka cha lugs mtshungs: g.yas brgyad me dpung ser ba bzhu zhing bsregs: g.yon brgyad rlung 'tshub ser sprin phyogs bcur gtor: khro bo'i chas rdzogs gar gyi nyams dgur ldan: zhabs kyis sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs rnams mnan: steng 'og phyogs mtshams khro bcu'i ngo bo la:

rnam pa rang dang 'dra ba'i khro bo bcu: phyogs mtshams gdon gnon sku las me chen 'bar: phyogs bcu'i ser lam gcod pa'i phrin las mdzod: ser gta' rnams kyang rang 'dra'i khro chung re: sprul pa'i khyung dang khro bo'i tshogs rnams kyis: gnam sa bar snang gang zhing sngags sgra sgrog: snye ma rnams kyang khro chung re re ste: nas 'bru rnams kyang hūm̐ yig re rer gsal: bcom ldan khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje mchu: khyung nag 'bar ba sprul pa yang sprul bcas: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bdag cag mi nor gnas khang bcas pa la: gza' klu'i gdon dang thog 'khyug gnod pa srungs: bdag gis srung ba'i lo thog thams cad la: ser ba'i gnod pa ma gtang thub par srungs: khro rgyal khyung dang bcas la skyabs zhus pas: skyob par mdzod cig badz+ra sa ma ya: oṃ badz+ra dun to i ka ni kon: tsa la ma la ti li: ma hā bha lin+ta khā hi khā hi: ma hā māṃ sa: ma hā rak+ta khā hi: de nas chad mdo ni: sngon tshe da lta tha ma'i bskal pa la: ma rungs snyigs ma rtsod ldan lha mi'i gnas: snang ba mtha' yas longs sku spyan ras gzigs: sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas rnams kyis ni: dkyil 'khor re re'i zhal phyes de yi tshe: dregs pa re re'i gzugs bstan srog snying phul: dam la ma 'da' bdag gi phrin las mdzod: bstan pa srung ba'i dus la ma babs sam: mgon skyabs byed pa'i dus la ma babs sam: gtor ma len pa'i dus la ma babs sam: dam bca' dran pa'i dus la ma babs sam: rtags mtshan ston pa'i dus la ma babs sam: oṃ dhe wa rak+ṣa sī bhi bha lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: hūm̐: sngon tshe ser bdag gdol pa bā su tas: thog ser rlung nag 'tshubs mas 'dzam gling gang: thub pas rdo rje mchu yi rgyud gsungs nas: dam btags srog snying phul nas khas blangs ltar: dam rdzas yid mthun dkar dmar gtor ma bzhes: bdag gis bsrung bya'i lo tog thams cad la: ser ba'i gnod pa ma gtang thub par srungs:

rdo rje mchu yi dam las ma 'da' zhig: thog ser bdag po khyab 'jug rā hu la: sprul pa'i gza' brgyad gdong mo bzhi dang bcas: rigs gsum mgon pos dam la btags pa'i tshe: bstan pa bsrung zhing gang bcol phrin las bsgrub: sngags pas mchod na mgon par khas blangs ltar: dam rdzas dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bdag gis bsrung bya'i lo thog thams cad la: ser ba ma gtang srung skyob las mdzod cig: ser bdag klu rgyal gzhon nu gtum po yis: lo grangs bcu gnyis bar du ser ba brgyabs: sog ma'ang med par byas pas sog ma med: de tshe thub dbang dang ni gsang bdag gis: 'khor tshogs drug khri bcas pa dam la btags: sngags 'chang bka' bzhin bsgrub par khas blangs ltar: dam rdzas dkar gsum gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bdag gis bsrung bya'i lo thog thams cad la: ser ba ma gtang srung ba'i las mdzod cig: sngon gyi dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: thang lha ser bdag bco brgyad dam btags pa'i: kha gnon rdo rje mchu yi sgrub thabs mdzad: de tshe bod yul ser bdag thams cad kyis: ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas ma 'da' bar: dam rdzas dkar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bdag gis bsrung bya'i lo tog thams cad la: ser ba ma gtang bsrung ba'i sdongs grogs mdzod: khams kyi seng ge brag tu slob dpon gyis: zla rgyas 'bri dbang la sogs khams phyogs kyi: gzhi bdag ser bdag thams cad dam la btags: de tshe ci ltar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: dam rdzas dkar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bdag gis bsrung bya'i lo tog thams cad la: ser ba ma gtang bsrung ba'i grogs mdzod cig: gu ru rdo rje gro lod skur bzhengs nas: lha 'dre gcig kyang ma lus dbang du bsdus: dam la btags shing srog snying phul ba'i tshe: slob dpon pad+ma'i mtshan tsam 'dzin pa yis: ci gsung bka' nyan bsgrub par ma byas na: lha srin de yi mgo 'gas snying tshig cing:

dmyal bar ltung ba'i dmod bor dam bcas pa: dam tshig gnyan po rjes su dran par mdzod: dam rdzas so so'i yid mthun gtor ma bzhes: bdag gis bsrung ba'i lo tog thams cad la: ser ba ma gtang ser ba thub par srungs: sngags 'chang bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: nā ga rā tsa rā hu la a ya ma du ru tsa sha na i daṃ ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: hūm̐: sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma yis: lha srin dam la btags pa rnams: sngon gyi dam bca' ma g.yel bar: rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod: ma ma hring hring ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi:

ser lam gnam gyi sgo yin phyir// gtor ma nub byang mtshams su 'bul// de nas bkra shis ni: hūm̐: dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi sku gsung thugs: dpal ldan bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog: dngos grub ma lus gtan la 'beb mdzad pa'i: yi dam rdo rje mchu yi bkra shis shog: bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin 'grub mdzad pa'i: sprul pa khyung nag 'bar ba'i bkra shis shog: gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad bsgral mdzad pa'i: chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog: hūm̐: sku gsum bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog: yi dam rdo rje mchu yi bkra shis shog: khyung nag 'bar ba nor lha'i bkra shis shog: gter srung dam can rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog: de nas bshags pa ni: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam bya khyung dgongs: bdag ni ma shes rmongs pa'i las dbang gis: bla ma rnams la ngan dang smad pa btang: de yang ma shes rmongs pa'i las dbang lags: mthol lo bshags so tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: yi dam lha la gshe dang bskur pa btab: de yang ma shes rmongs pa'i las dbang lags: mthol lo bshags so tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: mkha' 'gro rnams la gtor ma lo zlar 'gyangs: de yang ma shes rmongs pa'i las dbang lags: mthol lo bshags so tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: chos skyong rnams la mchod bstod rgyun chag shor: de yang ma shes rmongs pa'i las dbang lags: mthol lo bshags so tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: ces bshags so: de nas gshegs gsol ni: hūm̐: ser gta' rnams la bstims pa yi: khyung dang khro bo'i lha tshogs dgongs: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la: dgos 'dod dngos grub thams cad stsol: khro bo khyung gi tshogs rnams kyang: rang gnas gshegs sam ci bder bzhugs: gal te rang gnas gshegs gyur na: slar yang mchod bstod byed pa'i tshe: 'byon par zhu 'o sa ma ya: de nas bsdu ba ni: snang srid ma lus rang gi sku la bsdu: rang nyid thugs ka'i sngags 'khor la thim nas:

de yang dbus kyi hūm̐ dang hrīḥl thim: hūm̐ dang hrīḥyang mi dmigs nam mkha' ltar: ces brjod de yi ngang la mnyam par gzhag: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: kha thaṃ: gu h+ya: h+ya ma ha: ces pa 'di sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje dgung lo bcu gsum gser 'phyang cho 'phrul chen po'i zla'i tshes bdun nyin/ thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i zhal gzigs te rtsa gsum spyi'i las byang 'di nyid dngos su bka' bstsal pa'o// zhes pa la rdo rje mchu'i sgrub thabs las byang sbyar zhing*/ tshig sgyur 'os cung zad bsgyur/ chad mdo gsar du brtsams te rgyas par byas te gter blon rā ga a s+yas bsgrigs pa'i yi ge pa ni dge slong brtson 'grus te/ 'di la nyes 'gal mchis na chos bdag srung ma'i tshogs la bshags shing*/ ma 'ongs rtsam zan gyi mi rnams la mi 'jigs skyabs kyi sbyin pa chen por gyur cig /maṅga laṃ// ā+oṃ ghu hu ra hu sa he 'a dza la dha thā: sngags 'di bris la dung ngam dril bu la btags la dkrol ba'am bus na thog mi 'ong ngo: ྈྈྈྈྈྈ
